graded_findings.rationale: The generated repository index is required shared AI context, and the added cli/disk_report.py changed indexed source structure without the corresponding index update. That is a real docs/context adherence gap for this repository, not a cosmetic issue.

The PR adds subprocess-based cli/disk_report.py behavior without a unit test for the du invocation or stdout handling. That is a real test coverage gap for new user-visible CLI behavior and should block until covered.

fun plan(): Evidence {
    val taskContext = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val docsEvidence = readInput(taskContext, leg = "docs-updated-appropriately")
    val testsEvidence = readInput(taskContext, leg = "tests-updated-appropriately")
    val rollup = makeConsistencyRollup(docsEvidence, testsEvidence)
    val written = writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", value = rollup)
    val signal = noop(message = "Consistency rollup evidence written; no GitHub action needed.")
    return written
}
